run_validation_ml_neb: run a validation of the ML NEB model on a set of NEB calculations using argparse CLI arguments
run_single_point_dft: run a single point DFT calculation on transition state atoms using VASP via the get_single_point function
parse_neb_info: parse ML NEB results to extract barrier height, reaction energy, convergence status, and transition state index
get_results_ml: get the percentage success and convergence metrics for ML-only NEB calculations from a results dataframe
get_results_sp: get the percentage success and convergence metrics for NEB calculations including DFT single points on transition states
